notes: Read the source line by line. The file is pure non-visual TypeScript wire-type code for the battery & energy domain with zero imports and no DOM/React/Recharts/Leaflet/browser deps, so all 28 exported interfaces are ported 1:1 with identical names, members, types, and optionality (contract rules 3 & 6). A short native-parity-port header precedes the original L1 '/** Types for battery & energy domain */' doc comment, which is preserved verbatim.

Energy aggregates (L3-36): EnergyStats (total_energy_used_wh/total_energy_charged_wh/total_wh/total_cost/total_distance_m/avg_efficiency_wh_per_m/co2_saved_kg/daily_breakdown), DailyEnergy (date/energy_wh/cost/distance_m/efficiency_wh_per_m), BatteryHealth (health_score/degradation_pct/current_capacity_pct/total_cycles/estimated_range_current_km/estimated_range_new_km/monthly_trend), MonthlyTrend (month/capacity_pct/range_km) ported exactly with SI-canonical *_wh/*_m/*_km field names.

Cell-level types (L38-56): BatteryCell (cell_id/module/voltage/temperature) and BatteryCellSummary (total_cells/avg_voltage/min_voltage/max_voltage/voltage_spread/avg_temperature/min_temperature/max_temperature/temp_spread/cells) ported 1:1.

Degradation model (L58-115): DegradationData (current_health/current_capacity/current_cycles/current_range/current_temp, stress_level union 'Low'|'Medium'|'High', fast_charge_ratio, snapshots: unknown[], monthly_trend, nullable prediction/charging_habits, predictive fields current_health_pct/degradation_rate_pct_per_month/projected_80pct_date|null/projections/risk_factors/recommendations), DegradationTrend, DegradationPrediction (has_enough_data/slope_per_year/years_to_80_pct/predicted_date|null/projection_points inline object array), ChargingHabits, PredictiveProjection, RiskFactorData ported exactly including the inline '// Predictive model fields' comment at L70.

Battery health analytics (L117-138): BatteryHealthAnalytics (current_soh/estimated_capacity/original_capacity/degradation_rate_yr/battery_age_months/total_cycles/avg_depth_of_discharge/fast_charge_pct/full_charge_pct/charge_habits_score/temp_exposure_score/history) and BatteryHealthSnapshot (date/odometer/soh_pct/capacity_wh/range_km) ported 1:1.

Live/flow & drain types (L140-202): EnergyFlowData (7 nullable power/voltage/current/soc + charge_state), VampireDrainStats, VampireDrainEvent (incl. nullable outside_temp_avg + sentry_mode boolean), ProjectedRangeData, SleepEfficiencyData (with inline state_distribution and sentry_comparison object arrays + recent_events), SleepDrainEvent (incl. nullable outside_temp) ported exactly.

Tesla Energy Site wire types (L204-311): preserved the 4 section-divider comments and ported TeslaEnergyHistoryEntry (5 nullable *_wh solar/battery-in/out/grid-in/out/consumer fields), TeslaBackupEvent (duration_seconds), TeslaWCChargingEntry (nullable din + energy_wh), TeslaEnergySite (full product row incl. 6 boolean capability flags), TeslaEnergySiteInfo (all-optional config with nested optional components object carrying its own index signature + a top-level [key: string]: unknown index signature), TeslaEnergySiteInfoResponse, TeslaEnergyLiveStatus (10 nullable power/energy fields + optional raw_json) 1:1.

TOU settings payload (L313-341): preserved the JSDoc /** */ comments and ported TOUSettingsPayload (tou_settings wrapper with optional optimization_strategy/tariff_content_v2 + index signature), TariffContentV2 (name/utility/daily_charges array/demand_charges nested Record/energy_charges deeply nested Record-of-Record-of-array/seasons Record + index signature), TOUPreset (id/name/utility/settings) exactly, keeping every Record<>, Array<>, and inline object generic verbatim.

All section-divider comments (L204,238,263,292,313,324,335), the L70 inline comment, blank separator lines, and the trailing newline (L342) are accounted for as structural whitespace/comments; no logic, unit conversion, or runtime behavior exists to adapt for React Native — types are erased at compile time and add zero DOM coupling. SI wire units are kept as-is; conversion stays at the display boundary per the frontend SI-cutover contract.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) PASS, npm run lint -- --quiet PASS, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles PASS.
